name: Josh Hokit
summary: An unbeaten American heavyweight (10-0, 4-0 UFC, age 29) out of Jackson-Wink who came through the 2025 Contender Series. He wrestles, strikes in volume, and finishes with ground-and-pound. He beat Curtis Blaydes in a Fight of the Night brawl in April and stopped Derrick Lewis in June. Gane is a big step up in size and skill, and this is his first five-round fight.

how_they_fight.Striking: Very high volume: 177 significant strikes landed against Blaydes, which Gane's coach called a heavyweight record (MMA Junkie). He rocked Blaydes with right hands in R1 and R2 but was hurt himself in R1 (Cageside). Against Lewis he used a jab and punches to set up takedowns, then dropped him with a combination off the fence.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Wrestling is his base (about 3 takedowns per 15 minutes). Lewis: double-leg in R1, ground-and-pound that cut him, a brief mount and an armbar attempt, then the R2 finish; about four minutes of control (our data). Denzel Freeman: almost four minutes of control and 37 strikes to none. Contender Series: 6 of 13 takedowns. Fernand Lopez describes him as a wrestler who strikes, changes levels, and goes back to wrestling when the striking isn't working.
how_they_fight.Defense: Absorbs a lot when he trades: Blaydes landed 174 significant strikes on him and took him down twice in R1 (Cageside; our data). Never beaten, never stopped. Reach is a problem here: listed at 185 cm against Gane's 206 cm in our data.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Nine stoppages: six in R1, two in R2, one in R3. Went 15 hard minutes with Blaydes and kept throwing in R3. Has never fought past three rounds.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Loud and provocative outside the cage (diss tracks, run-ins with Bruce Buffer and Alex Pereira). Inside, he has been willing to brawl when he could wrestle (Blaydes). Lopez expects him to wrestle, but not right away, and expects a lot of exchanges on the feet.

patterns: Jab and punches to set up level changes
Huge striking volume, but takes a lot back
Six of nine stoppages in R1
concerns: Gives up about 21 cm of reach to Gane
Defensive striking; was hurt by Blaydes in R1
Has not faced a striker of Gane's level at range
keys_to_beat: Keep him at the end of the jab and kicks; punish his entries
Stuff the first takedowns; he goes back to wrestling when the striking isn't working

news.text: Booked for the heavyweight title against Ciryl Gane in the UFC 334 main event at Madison Square Garden.
Gane's head coach Fernand Lopez compared him to Cain Velasquez.
Jon Jones, who trained at Jackson-Wink, said Hokit 'very well could win'.
Jorge Masvidal picked him to take Gane down and break him on the mat. MMA Junkie's page also links reports that he sparred after being pepper-sprayed to prepare for eye pokes.
Opens as a +203 underdog at BetOnline.
